Upholding the principle of "Inviolability of Property," it is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.}} '''Averardo Vault''' is a [[Point of Interest]] and [[Instance]] located in {{Location|Averardo Vault (Area)|nocat=1}}. It is the largest bank in [[Rinascita]] and owned by the [[Montelli Family]]. It is also considered a [[Challenge]], and your [[Team]] cannot be changed once you enter Averardo Vault. During {{Quest|Veils Off in Sun or Shadow}} there will be [[enemies]] located within Averardo Vault, but they will not spawn if the quest is completed. ==NPCs== * [[Alfred]] * [[Cristoforo]] (During [[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]]) * [[Dimitri]] * [[Frete]] * [[Ludvika]] * [[Mosto]] * [[Oliver]] * [[Polis]] * [[Roberto]] * [[Thurber]] ==Challenge== {{Challenge Infobox |title = Averardo Vault |image = Averardo Vault Interior.png |type = Quest |description = The vault, controlled by the Montelli Family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
Inside, the vault features numerous depositories guarded by a formidable array of Echo Guards and advanced security devices, making it the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita. It defies any ordinary means of intrusion. |quest = Veils Off in Sun or Shadow |quest_type = Main |nation = Rinascita |region = Averardo Vault |area = Averardo Vault (Area) |recLevel = |requiredUL = }} ===Walkthrough=== ===Supply Chests=== * [[File:Basic Supply Chest Map Marker.png|30px|link=Supply Chest]] [[Basic Supply Chest]]×1 * [[File:Standard Supply Chest Map Marker.png|30px|link=Supply Chest]] [[Standard Supply Chest]]×4 * [[File:Advanced Supply Chest Map Marker.png|30px|link=Supply Chest]] [[Advanced Supply Chest]]×2 ===Enemies=== {{Enemy List|Chop Chop: Leftless*7;Chop Chop: Rightless*7;Chop Chop: Headless*1;Chop Chop*2;Fae Ignis*10;Tambourinist*5;Chest Mimic*3;Diurnus Knight*1;Vitreum Dancer*2 }} ==Archive== {{Description|A vault built by the Montelli family on the outskirts of the city.
